description: ArcGIS for Power BI lets you build beautiful maps using your data within Microsoft Power BI to unlock the power of location in your business intelligence. Using it is simple – it ships in the box, so just click the icon within Power BI to start mapping. You can also access Esri's global demographic data and basemaps. If your organization does not have location data, you can easily enable your tabular business data and combine it with Esri's global data for greater context. ArcGIS for Power BI also supports connecting to ArcGIS Online and ArcGIS Enterprise, Esri's industry-leading geospatial system. This means that you can easily use your spatial data in Power BI dashboards and reports and distribute it across your organization. ArcGIS for Power BI includes: Basemaps: Access a global collection ready-to-use basemaps with localized languages and geographies. Address Matching: Up to 10,000 points per map with no monthly limits. Content: Combine maps and data from the ArcGIS Living Atlas of the World catalog with your own Power BI business data (public, private, and Esri-sourced). Demographics: Tap into Esri-curated global demographic and lifestyle data for 120+ countries (over 8,000+ variables for the US alone).
